structural_breaks.note: Ind AS adoption from FY2018; FY2016-FY2017 quarters are IGAAP net-of-excise as originally filed
GST; FY2018Q1 uses company-printed revenue excluding excise duty
Shirdi Sai Electricals Ltd announced mandatory open offer after acquiring control from the Prolec GE group (filing on Prolec GE India letterhead); no change of reporting scope (standalone company)

profile.products: Power transformers up to 250 MVA (work under way to extend to 400 kV / 500 MVA by 2028), distribution transformers 100 kVA/11 kV to 5,000 kVA/33 kV, inverter/converter special application transformers, skid-mounted substations. Single segment (transformers). Installed capacity ~12,000 MVA, to 25,000 MVA (company website; AR FY2025-26).

plants.products: Large power transformers and distribution transformers (main plant, since 2008)

profile.end_markets: Indian transmission & generation utilities, hydro/wind/solar, DISCOMs, steel, cement, textiles. Almost entirely domestic: FY2025-26 revenue by geography India INR 78,109.44 lakh vs rest of world INR 98.47 lakh (AR FY26 p.140). Ownership: part of Prolec GE until Shirdi Sai Electricals Ltd's Dec-2019 open offer; SSEL is now the holding company.

proxy_routes.why: Indian electrical-equipment production — Indo Tech is ~100% domestic
India >10 MVA transformer exports — domestic power-transformer industry tightness/pricing
India 650-10,000 kVA exports — distribution transformer cycle
WISHLIST: CEA monthly substation transformation capacity additions (MVA) — physical demand for 220-400 kV transformers

collection_notes: fiscal_key 규칙: 인도 회계연도(4월~3월)를 '끝나는 해'로 표기 — FY2026Q1 = 2025-04-01~2025-06-30, FY2026Q4 = 2026-01-01~2026-03-31. period_end 는 원문 결산일(달력 분기말).
단위: INR million. 원문은 INR lakh(=0.1 million) 또는 crore(=10 million) 로 인쇄 — 배율 환산만 했고 (lakh×0.1, crore×10, XBRL INR÷1e6) 통화 환산·추정 없음. printed 값은 locator 에 원문 그대로 남김.
인도 Reg-33 결산의 1~3월(4분기) 3개월 칸은 '연간 감사치 − 12월 누계 공시치' 로 회사가 산출·인쇄한 balancing figure 이다. 인쇄된 3개월 칸을 그대로 쓰므로 method=direct_reported_quarter.

검증: 모든 분기 값은 (1) BSE 결과 DB(Corp_detailedResult / 연결 API, Rs. million) (2) NSE XBRL·NSE 결과 레코드 중 가용한 거래소 구조화 공시와 대조했고, (3) BSE 원문 PDF(텍스트층·pdfplumber·tesseract OCR)에서 같은 숫자를 찾으면 그 PDF를 source_url 로 둔다(verification 필드). PDF 셀을 읽지 못한 분기는 거래소 구조화 공시(XBRL/NSE 레코드/BSE DB)를 source_url 로 둔다(CONTRACT §0-1 예외).
